central_question: What do passive wrist signals reveal about persistent hypertension risk without measuring blood pressure directly?
claims_and_limits: Pretraining used 492,347 hours from 2,109 participants; the distinct prospective validation had 196 people at five US sites.
Initial screening against 24-hour ABPM gave reported sensitivity 65.8% and specificity 90.0%; the separate confirmatory subset had 48 people.
The watch yields a multi-day probability score, not a cuffless blood-pressure reading or standalone clinical diagnosis; Google describes the research methods as exploratory.

visual.shared_motif: Green smartwatch PPG and accelerometer signals; cover depicts a person and clinical referral, inner shows time aggregation and 24-hour cuff validation.
visual.status: Conceptual screening workflow, no direct BP measurement or numerical performance claim on artwork.
